turns.t: Ms Okonkwo, the booking says hepatitis B vaccination status. Tell me what's led to this. ~

Yes. I brought notes. I'm starting a placement as a dental nurse on Monday, and the occupational health form needs my hepatitis B immunity status. I had the three injections as a student, but I don't have the paperwork.
So you had three doses, but no certificate. When, roughly? ~
In 2014, I think. The first, then a month later, then six months after. ~
That's the right schedule. Have you had any symptoms, anything that's made you think of the liver?
Not exactly. I've been tired for about two weeks, but I've also been working nights, so, I can't say it means anything.
Anything else?
A bit of nausea last week, after a takeaway. It settled by itself.
So the nausea has gone. Anything else you want to mention before we go on? ~
Not really, I just want the form sorted, I'm that sort of person. ~
Any allergies I should know about, particularly latex, as you'll be working with gloves?
Latex, as a child. I got a rash on my hands from balloons. I haven't had it since, but I always wear nitrile now.
That's very useful, thank you. Any other health problems?
Eczema, mild.
What do you do at the moment?
I'm a healthcare assistant, nights. I've been doing it for four years.
Alcohol?
A glass of wine on Fridays.
Right. Let me check you. Pulse 68, blood pressure 114 over 70, temperature 36.5, oxygen 99 percent, breathing 14, weight 64 kilos.
Normal? ~
All normal. Look up for me.
Like this? ~
The whites of your eyes are a normal colour, no yellowing.
Good. ~
Now I'll press your tummy. Tell me if it's tender.
It's fine. ~
Your abdomen is soft and not tender, and I can't feel an enlarged liver.
That's reassuring. ~
So, no sign of any liver trouble. The tiredness is most likely the night shifts.
That's what I thought. ~
Let me repeat the plan back. You had three doses in 2014, there's no certificate, and the form needs proof. The way to get it is a blood test. ~
Yes. ~
I'd like to arrange a hepatitis B surface antibody blood test, and while we're at it, liver function tests.
And if the antibody is low? ~
Then we'll discuss a booster. We'll decide on that when the results are back. ~
That makes sense. When will the result be ready? ~
Usually within a week. Reception will text you. ~
Perfect. Will I need to fast? ~
No, you can eat normally. ~
Brilliant. ~
I'd like to see you again in a week to go through the results and sign your form.
That works. Monday's my start date, so it's tight, but fine. ~
I'll put it on the form that the result is pending. ~
Thank you, doctor. You've been very clear. ~
